description:
Cast White Sun's Twilight with X equal to 2 by paying {2}{W}{W}.
In response, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying White Sun's Twilight.
Resolve that copy, gaining 2 life and creating two 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Phyrexian Mite creatures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may repeat while skipping step 5 to gain infinite Phyrexian Mite tokens.
